payload._note: The 10-K explicitly states in the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements (Note 1): 'No single customer comprised more than 10% of net sales for the years ended December 31, 2023, 2022 and 2021.' Therefore, no named customer concentration exists above the SEC's 10% reporting threshold. The company provides software solutions and tech-enabled services for regulatory compliance and financial transactions, which includes both recurring software subscriptions and project-based transactional work (capital markets deals, SEC filings, etc.). No specific customer names, revenue percentages, or top customer concentration data is disclosed anywhere in the filing.
